result.topic_en: Riemann discusses small oscillations of the fluid ellipsoid about the equilibrium form (second-order expansion of G, periodic solutions via trigonometric functions), comments on Dirichlet's treatment and on general Fourier-series solutions, and then begins to recast the differential equations (A) in a more symmetric form using new variables g, h, k and g_1, h_1, k_1.

methods.what: Linearised equations for small deviations of the semi-axes from the equilibrium (minimum of G)
Harmonic ansatz: second time derivative of each deviation equals -μμ times the deviation; μμ determined so that one equation follows from the others
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 \delta a}{\partial t^2} = -\mu\mu\,\delta a$, $\frac{\partial^2 \delta b}{\partial t^2} = -\mu\mu\,\delta b$, also $\frac{\partial^2 \delta c}{\partial t^2} = -\mu\mu\,\delta c$

methods.what: Determining μμ by requiring a quadratic form to be the square of a linear expression; gives two positive values when both forms are positive definite
General solution of the small-oscillation problem as a superposition of two periodic modes
methods.quote: von der Form $\sin(\mu t + \mathrm{const.})$ [-proportional-] ändern und aus denen sich ihre allgemeine Lösung zusammensetzen läßt

methods.what: Argument for finite periodic oscillations: a return-map argument using abc = const. and conservation of kinetic energy, reducing periodicity to two conditions
